verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. The authenticated comparison is now conservatively annotated with secx:SemiHonest, so malicious-security selection excludes it alongside every other annotated MPC protocol. The replacement headline test pins that fail-closed exclusion, while the accompanying ontology comments and public guidance explicitly identify the second-operand adoption weakness and require an end-to-end adversarial witness before the classification may be strengthened. The positive claims remain Claimed with ExternalSignOffPending, and the crate is consistently described as research-grade and externally unaudited. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is apparent in the changed surface.
